author: SEGAtard
quote: At first, I thought I was going to experience the greatest gaming experience of this era. Turns out that I was wrong. The game has too many glaring shortcomings and I'm not even talking about the glitchyness of it all. My complaints are more fixated on the narrative, which I find unreasonably confined compared to the less linear previous installments within the franchise. The crazy humor is missing. How unfortunate because the exaggerated goofiness is what made ****... Furthermore, the fact that autoplay mode is available nulls the existence of the game from the start. GTA VI takes itself too seriously, forgetting the fact about being a game.
